title: SWF: placement re-emit drops per-placement effects on bitmap/shape MOVE paths (filter/blend/tint tweens broken)
description:
Class of place-vs-move asymmetry: a per-placement effect handled on first placement is dropped on posChanged/Move re-emit. Because motion tweens make posChanged fire every frame, the effect is lost for the whole tween. Sites: (1) HIGH scene bitmap move packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts:1332-1362 handles only alpha/visible, no blendMode/filters/colorEffect -> a bitmap filter tween (filtersKey is in posChanged) emits plain PlaceObject2, Ruffle drops the filter after frame 1. First-placement (frames.ts:704-739) uses PlaceObject3 correctly. (2) sprite bitmap move sprite.ts:1077-1093 bare encodePlaceObject2Move else -> drops colorEffect/visible/alpha; also first-placement sprite.ts:846-859 omits standalone alpha. (3) scene shape move frames.ts:1246-1259 else drops general colorEffect (tint/brightness/advanced); colorEffectKey serializes it so posChanged fires. (4) sprite shape sprite.ts:749-782 (first) and 1008-1029 (move) have no colorEffect case at all. Root fix: factor a single 'encode placement for (displayObj, move) with full effect set' helper shared by frames.ts and sprite.ts (check blend/filters/colorEffect/visible/alpha, emit PlaceObject3 when needed). Acceptance: Ruffle e2e for bitmap+filter tween and shape+tint tween. Confidence: confirmed; no current test covers bitmap+blend/filter.

RESOLUTION (task 1375): Fixed place-vs-move asymmetry dropping per-placement effects on bitmap/shape MOVE re-emits. Added shared helper packages/swf/src/placement-effects.ts (effectCXForm: colorEffect > visible=false > alpha precedence). Routed 4 broken sites through it: scene bitmap MOVE (frames.ts, added blend/filters/colorEffect; was alpha-only), scene shape MOVE else (frames.ts, added general colorEffect/tint), sprite bitmap MOVE else + FIRST (sprite.ts, added colorEffect/visible/alpha), sprite shape MOVE else + FIRST (sprite.ts, added colorEffect/alpha). alpha/visible byte output unchanged (WithCXForm alpha-only == old WithAlpha).

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> exit 0. pnpm --filter @flash/swf test --run -> 119 files, 1479 tests passed (incl new __tests__/placement-effect-move.test.ts, 4 tests: scene+sprite bitmap-filter and shape-tint tweens re-emit the effect on every moved frame, zero plain moves). Docs: docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md updated.
